text_en: After this the Moabites and Ammonites, and with them some of the Meunites, came against Jehoshaphat for battle.
text_cn: 此后，摩阿布人、阿孟人，还有一些玛红人前来攻打约沙法特。

text_en: Messengers came and told Jehoshaphat, “A great multitude is coming against you from Edom, from beyond the sea; already they are at Hazazon-tamar” (that is, En-gedi).
text_cn: 有人来告诉约沙法特说：“由海那边，由厄东有一支大军前来攻击你；他们现已到达哈匝宗塔玛尔，即恩革狄。”

text_en: Jehoshaphat was afraid; he set himself to seek the Lord , and proclaimed a fast throughout all Judah.
text_cn: 约沙法特害了怕，一面恳求上主，一面宣布全犹大禁食。

text_en: Judah assembled to seek help from the Lord ; from all the towns of Judah they came to seek the Lord .
text_cn: 犹大人遂集会，求上主援助；犹大各城的人也前来祈求上主。

text_en: Jehoshaphat stood in the assembly of Judah and Jerusalem, in the house of the Lord , before the new court,
text_cn: 约沙法特在犹大和耶路撒冷的会众中，站在上主殿宇的新院前，

text_en: and said, “O Lord , God of our ancestors, are you not God in heaven? Do you not rule over all the kingdoms of the nations? In your hand are power and might, so that no one is able to withstand you.
text_cn: 说：“上主，我们祖先的天主！你不是天上的天主吗？你不是治理万国万民的么？你手中有能力和权威，没有谁能抵抗你。

text_en: Did you not, O our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it forever to the descendants of your friend Abraham?
text_cn: 我们的天主！不是你将这地方的居民，在你百姓以色列面前赶走，将这地方永远赐给了你友人亚巴郎的后代吗？

text_en: They have lived in it, and in it have built you a sanctuary for your name, saying,
text_cn: 他们现在住在这地方，并在这地方为你的名建造了圣殿说：

text_en: ‘If disaster comes upon us, the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house, and before you, for your name is in this house, and cry to you in our distress, and you will hear and save. ’
text_cn: 如果我们遭遇了祸患，刀兵灾害，或瘟疫饥馑，我们站在这殿前和你面前，在灾难中向你呼吁，你必予以垂听，施行拯救，因为你的名在这殿内。

text_en: See now, the people of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade when they came from the land of Egypt, and whom they avoided and did not destroy—
text_cn: 现在你看，阿孟人、摩阿布人以及色依尔山中的人，这些人是以色列出离埃及时，你曾禁止以色列侵犯，以色列便绕道远离，未加消灭的人。

text_en: they reward us by coming to drive us out of your possession that you have given us to inherit.
text_cn: 你看他们如何报复我们，要来驱逐我们离开你赐予我们为基业的地方。

text_en: O our God, will you not execute judgment upon them? For we are powerless against this great multitude that is coming against us. We do not know what to do, but our eyes are on you. ”
text_cn: 我们的天主，你不惩罚他们么？我们实在没有力量抵抗来攻击我们的这支庞大的军队，我们也不知道该作什么，我们的眼睛惟有仰望你。”

text_en: Meanwhile all Judah stood before the Lord , with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
text_cn: 当时全犹大民众，连他们全家妻子儿女，都立在上主面前。

text_en: Then the spirit of the Lord came upon Jahaziel son of Zechariah, son of Benaiah, son of Jeiel, son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, in the middle of the assembly.
text_cn: 上主的神在会众中临于肋未人阿撒夫的后裔，玛塔尼雅的玄孙，耶依耳的曾孙，贝纳雅的孙子，则加黎雅的儿子雅哈齐耳身上，

text_en: He said, “Listen, all Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, and King Jehoshaphat: Thus says the Lord to you: ‘Do not fear or be dismayed at this great multitude; for the battle is not yours but God’s.
text_cn: 他遂说：“全犹大人，耶路撒冷的居民以及约沙法特王，都要静听！上主这样对你们说：你们不要为这支庞大军队害怕，因为战争不在乎你们，而在乎天主。

text_en: Tomorrow go down against them; they will come up by the ascent of Ziz; you will find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
text_cn: 明天你们要下去迎敌，他们要由漆兹山坡上来，你们要在耶鲁耳旷野前的谷口遇到他们。

text_en: This battle is not for you to fight; take your position, stand still, and see the victory of the Lord on your behalf, O Judah and Jerusalem. ’ Do not fear or be dismayed; tomorrow go out against them, and the Lord will be with you. ”
text_cn: 这次你们无须交战，只须布阵以待，观看上主为你们所行的救援。犹大和耶路撒冷，不必畏惧，不必害怕！明天你们只管出去迎敌，因为上主与你们同在。”

text_en: Then Jehoshaphat bowed down with his face to the ground, and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell down before the Lord , worshiping the Lord .
text_cn: 约沙法特遂俯首至地，犹大民众和耶路撒冷居民也都俯伏在上主面前，朝拜上主。

text_en: And the Levites, of the Kohathites and the Korahites, stood up to praise the Lord , the God of Israel, with a very loud voice.
text_cn: 刻哈特子孙和科辣黑子孙中的肋未人起立，引吭(háng)高歌，赞颂上主以色列的天主。

text_en: They rose early in the morning and went out into the wilderness of Tekoa; and as they went out, Jehoshaphat stood and said, “Listen to me, O Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem! Believe in the Lord your God and you will be established; believe his prophets. ”
text_cn: 次日，他们一早就起来，开往特科亚旷野；在出发时，约沙法特立起来说：“犹大和耶路撒冷的居民，请听我的话！你们信赖上主你们的天主，必保生命；相信他的先知，必定胜利。”

text_en: When he had taken counsel with the people, he appointed those who were to sing to the Lord and praise him in holy splendor, as they went before the army, saying, “Give thanks to the Lord , for his steadfast love endures forever. ”
text_cn: 他与百姓商定之后，便派歌咏人员赞颂上主，身穿圣洁服装，走在军队前面，歌颂说：“你们应赞颂上主，因为他的慈爱永远常存！”

text_en: As they began to sing and praise, the Lord set an ambush against the Ammonites, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Judah, so that they were routed.
text_cn: 他们正歌颂赞美时，上主派出伏兵， 袭击了那些来攻击犹大的阿孟人、摩阿布人和色依尔山地的居民；他们便被击败了。

text_en: For the Ammonites and Moab attacked the inhabitants of Mount Seir, destroying them utterly; and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, they all helped to destroy one another.
text_cn: 阿孟人和摩阿布人起来攻击色依尔山地的居民，决心将他们杀尽灭绝；歼灭了色依尔山地居民以后，他们又自相残杀。

text_en: When Judah came to the watchtower of the wilderness, they looked toward the multitude; they were corpses lying on the ground; no one had escaped.
text_cn: 犹大人到了俯瞰旷野的高岗上，观望大军，见伏尸遍野，没有一个逃脱的。

text_en: When Jehoshaphat and his people came to take the booty from them, they found livestock in great numbers, goods, clothing, and precious things, which they took for themselves until they could carry no more. They spent three days taking the booty, because of its abundance.
text_cn: 约沙法特遂带他的军民去掠夺敌人的财物，见有大批的牲畜、财物、衣服和宝物；足足掠取了三天，夺得的财物多得不能携带，因为实在太多。

text_en: On the fourth day they assembled in the Valley of Beracah, for there they blessed the Lord ; therefore that place has been called the Valley of Beracah to this day.
text_cn: 第四天，他们聚集在巴辣加谷，在那里赞颂了上主，为此给那地起名叫巴辣加谷， 直到今天。

text_en: Then all the people of Judah and Jerusalem, with Jehoshaphat at their head, returned to Jerusalem with joy, for the Lord had enabled them to rejoice over their enemies.
text_cn: 此后，犹大和耶路撒冷所有的军民，由约沙法特率领，凯旋回了耶路撒冷，因为上主使他们战胜仇敌，因而异常欢乐，

text_en: They came to Jerusalem, with harps and lyres and trumpets, to the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 都弹着琴，鼓着瑟，吹着号，来到耶路撒冷，进了上主的殿。

text_en: The fear of God came on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that the Lord had fought against the enemies of Israel.
text_cn: 列国的民族一听说上主击败了以色列的敌人，都对天主起了恐怖的心。

text_en: And the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet, for his God gave him rest all around.
text_cn: 约沙法特的王国于是获享太平，因为天主赐他四境平安。

text_en: So Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah. He was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; he reigned twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Azubah daughter of Shilhi.
text_cn: 约沙法特为犹大王，即位时年三十五岁，在耶路撒冷为王凡二十五年；他的母亲名叫阿组巴，是史肋希的女儿。

text_en: He walked in the way of his father Asa and did not turn aside from it, doing what was right in the sight of the Lord .
text_cn: 约沙法特走了他父亲阿撒的道路，未偏左右，行了上主视为正义的事；

text_en: Yet the high places were not removed; the people had not yet set their hearts upon the God of their ancestors.
text_cn: 只是丘坛没有铲除，人民仍没有全心全意归向他们祖先的天主。

text_en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, from first to last, are written in the Annals of Jehu son of Hanani, which are recorded in the Book of the Kings of Israel.
text_cn: 约沙法特前后其余的事迹，都记载在哈纳尼之子耶胡的《言行录》上；这《言行录》收集在《以色列列王实录》内。

text_en: After this King Jehoshaphat of Judah joined with King Ahaziah of Israel, who did wickedly.
text_cn: 此后，犹大王约沙法特与作恶多端的以色列王阿哈齐雅联盟，

text_en: He joined him in building ships to go to Tarshish; they built the ships in Ezion-geber.
text_cn: 合伙制造船只，开往塔尔史士去；他们合力在厄兹雍革贝尔制造了一些船。

text_en: Then Eliezer son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, “Because you have joined with Ahaziah, the Lord will destroy what you have made. ” And the ships were wrecked and were not able to go to Tarshish.
text_cn: 玛勒沙人多达瓦的儿子厄里厄则尔讲预言攻击约沙法特说： “因为你与阿哈齐雅联盟，上主必要破坏你所造的船只。”后来那些船只果然遭受破坏，未能开往塔尔史士。
